evidence: One-dimensional columns of heat and water on committed products and published values: the airless crust's temperatures from Apollo and Diviner with Warren & Rasmussen's megaregolith; conduction solved implicitly with the crust's properties changing as air and water fill it; Green-Ampt infiltration through Manning & Ingebritsen's permeability at lunar gravity, the water stopping where the rock is below freezing and the floors' sediment sealing them as it builds up. The air and water arrive at once with the planned climate; the build's own warming, delivery heat, lateral flow, the heat the inflowing water carries, hydrothermal circulation and trapped air are outside it. Earth's values are reference points; design guesses are named.
reading_rule: Years from the moment the planned climate and the water are in place. Depths in m below the floor or ground; held water in m of water a square metre of floor or ground; Moon-wide amounts as a global layer in m, as kg and as a share of the seas' 1.07e19 kg. The seas' fall is the held water spread over the seas' area without top-up, and the share the seas would keep follows the atlas's levels. A frozen layer is the depth range below freezing; a column is thawed through once no part of it is.
